mathematical_review.method: Three topic agents read the primary sources and wrote scoped packets. The coordinating agent read every new knowledge page and outline, checked selected source passages independently, reviewed proof calculations and corrected prerequisite targets before the final build.
corrected: Complex second variation retains the site's scalar-normal sign convention, first-variable-linear Hermitian convention and curvature normalization.
The torus phase construction respects horizontal and vertical monodromy; bundle classification retains indecomposability.
Stable, cover-stable, finite-total-curvature and genus hypotheses are distinguished. The fundamental-group statement concerns rank two, not order two.
The three-dimensional ancient cylindrical classification is restricted to (n,k)=(2,1) and retains unit regularity and mod-2 cyclicity.
Inner/outer flows, moving-center limits, general Brakke flows and multiplicity-one hypotheses are distinguished. Local mean-convex comparison is restricted to the spatial ball.

Bamler-Lai v1 is dated December 2025, after the October 2025 report preprint and before publication of the proceedings. It is identified as a preprint, not described as an exhaustive literature update.
Central-fibre multiplicities are retained in mass formulas. Perturbed generic-fibre mass is (1+epsilon)^n V.
The fixed-model theorem uses actual restricted classes in the simplex argument. The Sperner proof handles the one-vertex case and boundary values.
The non-Archimedean homeomorphism uses strong topologies on both sides. Model existence does not assert uniqueness of a divisor.
The envelope orthogonality deduction uses the correct one-sided Lelong estimate and preserves multiplicities, rather than copying erroneous signs in a source display.
Basic topology, linear algebra, holomorphic bundles and embedded-submanifold links were checked; specialized terms do not link to unrelated similarly named definitions.
mathematical_review.boundary: Elementary calculations and selected deductions are written step by step. Deep classification, regularity, compactness and pluripotential results retain precise cited inputs or proof outlines. The three source packets record unexpanded branches; these 110 pages are not a complete reconstruction of every research proof. The pre-existing foundation forest was reused, not independently rereviewed in full.
mathematical_review.terminology: Existing site terminology and primary-source definitions were checked. External Banana Space access was unavailable; no completed terminology concordance is claimed.

source_checks.scanner_boundary: Nine new term candidates were read: subject-page navigation text, symmetry group rather than permutation group, and line-bundle terminology already reached through specialized definitions or used in an explanatory comparison. No new wrong-target candidate remains. Existing site-wide scanner candidates and one older editorial candidate remain outside this batch; passing scans are not a mathematical proof certificate.

static_build.repair: A half-open time interval in 2M07 was rewritten with lparen/rbrack commands to avoid Forester's literal-bracket parser. Final source snapshots and tests use the corrected form.

browser_checks.visual_review: All three outline screenshots inspected at desktop and mobile widths; heading wrapping, formula rendering, paragraph spacing and link presentation retain the existing theme.
browser_checks.runtime_note: The sandboxed Chrome launch aborted; the same test passed in an approved isolated headless Chrome process with a temporary profile.

publication: Local static build and preview on port 8083 only. No commit, push or GitHub Pages deployment requested for this batch.
